articles.title: Adani plans Rs 1.8 lakh crore defence spend to boost indigenous military capabilities
articles.summary: Adani Group plans a substantial investment of Rs 1.8 lakh crore next year into defence manufacturing, aiming to significantly strengthen India's capabilities. The primary focus will be on advanced areas like unmanned and autonomous systems, alongside guided weapons. This move is crucial for enhancing the nation's self-reliance and technological prowess in defence, aligning with strategic national security objectives and the 'Make in India' initiative for military hardware.

articles.title: 7 Fantasy Movies That Aged Incredibly Poorly
articles.summary: This article explains how nostalgia powerfully distorts memory, leading us to perceive past entertainment, especially within the fantasy genre, as flawless. It underscores a psychological bias, reminding aspirants to critically evaluate information and avoid romanticizing the past. Understanding such cognitive phenomena is crucial for clear decision-making.

articles.title: 2025: The Turning Point in India’s Technological Self-Determination
articles.summary: The year 2025 is identified as a pivotal moment for India's scientific and technological progress. During this period, the nation significantly boosted its confidence and achieved enhanced global recognition across numerous frontier domains. This underscores India's growing prominence and strategic focus on innovation, signaling its intent to lead in advanced technological sectors and strengthen its international stature through scientific breakthroughs.

articles.title: PM Modi lauds Op Sindoor, Mahakumbh, Ram temple completion, Indian in space in 2025
articles.summary: In his final Mann ki Baat address of 2025, Prime Minister Narendra Modi declared the year a period of significant national achievements. He highlighted notable accomplishments such as 'Operation Sindoor' and other installations, affirming a productive year for the nation. This review of progress aimed to inspire citizens by showcasing the collective successes and future aspirations discussed during his monthly radio broadcast, underscoring national development.

articles.title: Robert Crumb And Roberta Gregory in Fantagraphics March 2026 Solicits
articles.summary: Fantagraphics announces upcoming comic releases for March 2026, featuring Robert Crumb's 'Art And Beauty' and Roberta Gregory's 'Complete Bitchy Bitch'. This news pertains to the publishing and cultural sector, reflecting artistic output. While not directly defence or policy-related, it showcases a segment of national cultural activity.

articles.title: Israel takes delivery of Iron Beam laser air defence system
articles.summary: Israel's military has taken delivery of Iron Beam, a high-power laser interception system. This advanced technology will be integrated into its existing multi-layered missile shields. This acquisition significantly enhances Israel's air defence capabilities, providing an additional layer of protection against various aerial threats and bolstering national security.
